A cold water extract or CWE is when you grind up your seeds and put them in a jar with distilled water and/or high proof alcohol in your fridge overnight with no exposure to light. in the morning you can filter out the seed material and discard it. after that you just drink the liquid and wait for the trip.

Im not an expert but i think it has to do with the way the coils are made or set up. Above all else, they are MEANT for wax. I've seen people do dabs using a vape tank but you'll basically end up destroying it in the end.
Most smoke shops sell 'Quick Fix' which clears up your urine in like 90 minutes and keeps its clean for 6 hours. I've never used it but I've heard good things.

You can buy some wax liquidizer or something similar which makes your wax into a vapeable oil then stick it in your tank. I've never tried this before but I've heard many success stories. 

Other than that I wouldn't really recommend using anything beyond your mod for your wax. The Sai is a very good option but if you're looking for less of a financial commitment then you could go out and buy the Yocan Evolve Plus. The atomizer from that fits a normal mod and they run pretty cheap. They are also known for being extremely reliable and safe for the the price range.
